No photo shows the sensor specs, shutter count, AF performance, or the camera’s menu/EXIF/benchmark screens.

claims.evidence: Photos show the Nikon D3300 and 18-55mm VR II kit, but not the sensor specification screen or documentation.
No photo/video of the camera’s continuous shooting settings or a performance test.
No photo of AF point display/menu or a test showing 3D tracking behavior.

risks.risk: Shutter count / heavy wear (affects value and reliability). Photos cannot show shutter count.
risks.proof: A screenshot from the camera menu showing shutter count (or a computer report from Nikon software/third-party tool).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case used condition (assume higher shutter count / normal wear) until shutter count is provided.

risks.risk: Lens condition issues (fungus, haze, scratches, oil on blades) not reliably visible in these photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens elements (front and rear) against a bright light, plus a short video of the focus ring and aperture behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not-fully-verified lens condition (assume possible minor defects) until clear element photos are provided.

risks.risk: Sensor dust/fog or dead pixels (can’t be confirmed from these images).
risks.proof: A test photo of a blank white wall at f/16 (or lens cap on) and a 100% crop showing dust/dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case for image cleanliness (assume dust/dead pixels possible) until a test shot is shown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories / battery health (battery not shown; charger/strap not shown).
risks.proof: A full photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger, strap, caps, USB cable, manuals) and a photo of the battery label/charge indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body+kit only with unknown accessory completeness until the full bundle is confirmed.

risks.risk: Functionality (AF, VR, buttons, ports) not testable from photos.
risks.proof: Short video showing: autofocus on a moving subject, VR on/off behavior (handheld shake test), and a quick menu navigation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working perfectly (worst-case) until a functional test is provided.

proof_requests: Shutter count screenshot/report for the D3300.
Front and rear lens element close-ups against bright light (fungus/haze/scratches).
A sample test photo (white wall at f/16) with 100% crop for dust/dead pixels.
Photos of the full included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, cables).
Short video demonstrating autofocus and VR operation.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Nikon D3300 with the 18-55mm VR II kit lens, but the seller’s performance/spec claims and key value drivers (shutter count, sensor/lens condition, and full functionality) are not verifiable from the provided images. To price confidently in Lagos, the decisive proof items above are needed.
